facts.name: Project document list
facts.described_as: List this project's document register: each document's filename, type, and size. Use this when the user asks WHAT documents/files the project has. To search INSIDE document content use search_project_documents.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.label: number of documents
inputs.described_as: Max documents to return (default 100, newest first).

hints.purpose: Lists the documents this project holds, with file name, type and size, so the model knows what exists before it searches or reads one.

not_to_be_confused_with.difference: That one looks inside the documents' text; this one only names the documents.
That one returns a document's text; this one returns the register of documents.

question_kinds.how: A list of file names does not hold the passage a single-passage question needs; search instead.
Finds which documents are bills, so the bill row tool can be pointed at the right one.
Shows which documents are specifications and which are bills before searching each.
Shows which documents are specifications and which are drawings before searching each.
